stories.title: Tyjae Spears goes on IR a day after Br0phy put him in the FLEX, and Wild Goose Chase has nobody on the bench to replace him
stories.dek: The Titans moved Spears to injured reserve on Saturday. Br0phy has until Titans at Cowboys to find a ninth starter, and the only healthy answers are on waivers.
body: Br0phy did the right thing Friday night. Tucker Kraft was in the Wild Goose Chase FLEX with Green Bay on bye, so at 11:32 PM he added Tyjae Spears, who had practiced fully and was listed questionable, and started him. Then on Saturday the Titans put Spears on injured reserve with the knee injury he's been playing through since October, per NBC Sports. He misses at least four games. As of 7 AM Sunday, Spears is still in the FLEX. Not a dumb move. A dead one.

Here's the problem: there is nobody on the bench. Drake Maye is out, Jordan Love, Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft are on bye with Green Bay, Dylan Sampson is on bye with Cleveland, RJ Harvey is on IR and the Seattle defense is on bye. Seven bench spots, zero playable players. The fix has to come off waivers, and the best healthy free agent with a game is Keon Coleman, 73.5 PPR points in 9 games, whom ChuckJ10 dropped Friday night. Darnell Washington (63.9) and Malachi Fields (63.0) are next. Br0phy has to drop somebody to do it, and Spears himself is the obvious cut.

The line moves. Wild Goose Chase was a 16.5-point favorite over Nothing to see here with the FLEX filled; with a zero in it, it's 13.5, a 67% favorite. Wild Goose Chase still leads 19.00 to 0.00 after Nico Collins (15.8) and Tyler Warren (3.2) played Thursday, and Bryce Young is the only quarterback on the roster with a game. Nothing to see here is 2-8 and has lost six straight, so the cushion is real, but the Climax Bracket has Wild Goose Chase as the 6 seed at 72%, and that's not a number you protect with an empty roster spot.

The rest of the Sunday watch list. Brock Bowers (ankle) is questionable for Llamageddon and the Raiders play Denver at 4:25 PM ET; his coach said he doesn't need to practice to play. Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) is questionable and starting for Breece'sBurdenDeflowered after one limited practice. Carnell Tate (shoulder) is questionable but trending toward playing for Ivefallenandicantgetup, and krunkdd already benched the doubtful Dalton Kincaid for Dawson Knox. Monday night, Washington's backfield decides two matchups: Rachaad White (heel, questionable) starts for Llamageddon, and FatMikeR has Jacory Croskey-Merritt starting and just added Austin Ekeler as insurance.

stories.title: Texans 26, Colts 3: Stroud of Turin banks 24.76 before NjigbaR Please! plays a snap
stories.dek: C.J. Stroud throws three touchdowns, the Houston defense takes the early lead for the Week 11 payout, and Jonathan Taylor gets 6.7 for Llamageddon.
body: Week 11 is on the board, and Stroud of Turin is the team smiling about it. C.J. Stroud went 21 of 27 for 194 yards, three touchdowns and an interception in Houston's 26-3 win over the Colts, good for 21.46 points, and Xavier Hutchinson, the $10 waiver claim RedDevil904 made Wednesday, added 3.3. That's a 24.76 to 0.00 lead on NjigbaR Please!, which had nobody in the game, in the Matchup of the Week. The line was Stroud of Turin by 11.5, and RedDevil904 is already up more than double that before Sunday.

The other Thursday games. Wild Goose Chase leads Nothing to see here 19.00 to 0.00: Nico Collins caught three passes for 58 yards and a touchdown (15.8) and Tyler Warren added 3.2, while Woody Marks sat out for ChuckJ10. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered leads Achane in the Membrane 16.00 to 15.40 in the strangest race of the night: the Houston defense held the Colts to 3 points for 16.0, and David Montgomery ran 26 times for 107 yards for 15.4. Llamageddon leads Lead Nagger 6.70 to 0.00 because Jonathan Taylor, the top-scoring running back on any roster in this league, ran into that same Houston defense.

On the benches: Dalton Schultz scored 2.1 for Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, Tank Dell (5.7) and Emari Demercado (4.9) scored for Lead Nagger, and Seth McGowan scored 6.48 for MY DAD IS DEAD before he was ruled out with a hamstring injury, per NFL Network's Jane Slater. Pudge247 added Demercado as a free agent Wednesday, so at least he put up something, just not anywhere it counts.

The Week 11 payout is the highest-scoring defense, and the Houston defense on Breece'sBurdenDeflowered leads with 16.0. The other 11 starting defenses play Sunday and Monday. The Climax Bracket now counts each Thursday leader as a Week 11 winner, which moves Stroud of Turin to the 3 seed and drops Lead Nagger to the 5 seed. Lead Nagger is still the projected champion, at 21%, and Stroud of Turin has the best title odds at 23%.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker trades Jordan Addison to Pudge247 for Chimere Dike, and I'd like a word with myself
stories.dek: The commish's receiver room lost Wan'Dale Robinson for the season and Addison to thumb surgery in the same week. So he traded one for a Titan.
body: The trade, processed Nov 19 at 9:04 AM ET: My Dad is Dead2 gets Chimere Dike, Lead Nagger gets Jordan Addison. That's it, one for one. Addison had thumb surgery this week; Kevin O'Connell said it went well and that Addison will not go on injured reserve, but there is no return date, per 4for4. Dike has 13 catches and 29.5 PPR points in 9 games per Sleeper and scored 10.34 on the Lead Nagger bench in Week 10.

Why I did it, since I'm the one who did it: my receivers are falling apart. Titans coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Wan'Dale Robinson is out for the season with an ankle injury (TSN). Robinson had 81.3 points in 9 games on my bench. Addison was out this week regardless, and Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield are on the Rams' bye. Dike plays for the same Tennessee team that just lost Robinson, so somebody has to catch Cam Ward's passes, and I'm betting it's my guy. Dike is in my Week 11 lineup. I also dropped Tutu Atwell Wednesday night, which was the least controversial move I've made all year.

Why Pudge247 did it: Addison has 53.9 points in 7 games this year, including 21.0 in Week 3 (on my bench, naturally), and Lead Nagger has the most points in the league and a deep enough roster to park a receiver until he's back for a playoff run. Pudge247 also added Emari Demercado as a free agent the same morning. Lead Nagger is the projected champion; he's shopping for January, and I'm shopping for Sunday.

Verdict: too early to call, and it's in the trade history as such. If Dike gets Robinson's targets and Addison misses a month, I win the trade. If Addison is back for the Wild Card round and Dike keeps catching two balls a game, I traded a starter for a guy I'll cut in December. Either way, I'm 7-3, the projected 2 seed, and I just made a trade with the projected champion. Somebody check on me.

columns.title: THE RAMS ARE ON BYE, DSTAFFORD4254. Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner has a question about Friday night
columns.dek: A team down 24.76 doesn't need a defense with no game. It needs a GROWN-UP.
body: I've been in this press box since the fax machine was cutting-edge technology and I have NEVER seen a sixty-second roster move like the one dstafford4254 pulled at 11 o'clock Friday night. He drops the Cincinnati defense. He adds the LOS ANGELES RAMS defense. The Rams are ON BYE. One minute later he drops the Rams and adds Carolina. ONE MINUTE.

Let me lay out where NjigbaR Please! is. 7-3. Scores 123.96 a week. The second-best all-play record in this league at 67-43. And DOWN 24.76 to 0.00 to Stroud of Turin after C.J. Stroud threw three touchdowns Thursday night. Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Kyren Williams, Harold Fannin Jr., KC Concepcion Jr., ALL on bye. This is the week you need to be SHARP. And instead we get a man speed-dating the bye list at 11 PM.

And it's not just the defense! Same minute, practically, he drops Dohnte Meyers, 52.8 points this year, for Myles Price, 29.5 points this year, and STARTS Price. Now, is there a reason? Sure. Jordan Addison is out for Minnesota Sunday, and somebody has to catch passes up there. I'll give him that. ONE reason. But you're trading the guy with MORE POINTS for the guy with FEWER POINTS on a hunch at 10:59 PM, and I am sitting here going, who is ADVISING this man?

I'm HEARING things, and I want to be clear nobody can confirm a word of this. Word around the league is dstafford4254 added the Rams defense on purpose because he believes bye-week defenses "can't give up points," and he only dropped them after his phone autocorrected "Rams" to "Raps" and he panicked about basketball eligibility. I'm told he's now drafting a formal proposal for a ROSTER SLOT that only bye-week players can occupy. None of this is confirmed. All of it sounds right to me.

Here's what IS real. The Climax Bracket just slid NjigbaR Please! from the 2 seed to the 4 seed with that Thursday deficit counted as a loss, playoff odds down to 91%. Stroud of Turin is now the 3 seed with the BEST TITLE ODDS IN THE LEAGUE at 23%. RedDevil904 sat back and let C.J. Stroud do the work. dstafford4254 is up past bedtime adding defenses that don't have a GAME.

SO HERE IT IS. You are a CONTENDER. You have Ashton Jeanty. You have Tetairoa McMillan, 131.0 points. You have Travis Kelce. You do NOT need to touch the waiver wire at 11 PM like a man looking for his car keys in the fridge. SET THE LINEUP. CLOSE THE APP. GO TO BED. That's the take. I'm not taking questions.

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: krunkdd fixed his tight end before Saturday. That's what a first-place team looks like
columns.dek: Kincaid doubtful, Henry on bye, Knox in the lineup by 1:20 Friday afternoon. Nobody else in this league is that boring, and that's the point.
body: I played linebacker. You know what got guys cut? Not being where you were supposed to be. Fantasy is the same. Ivefallenandicantgetup is 8-2 with five straight wins, and on Friday I watched why.

Dalton Kincaid missed practice all week with thumb and ankle injuries and is doubtful for Sunday. Hunter Henry, the backup plan, is on bye with New England. Most of you would find out Sunday at 12:55. krunkdd added Dawson Knox at 1:20 PM Friday, dropped Henry, and started Knox. Knox has 28.6 points in 9 games. That's not pretty. It's a body on the field, and a body on the field beats Tucker Kraft in a FLEX spot on a bye, which is where Br0phy was until 11:32 Friday night.

Br0phy did fix it, and I'll give him half credit. He added Tyjae Spears, who practiced fully Friday and is questionable at Dallas, and put him in Kraft's spot. Spears has 30.9 points in 7 games. You're leading 19.00 to 0.00, you're a 16.5-point favorite, and you nearly gave away a starter because you didn't look at the bye list for four days. Soft.

Sources say, and I want everybody to know this isn't confirmed, that krunkdd sets his lineup on a whiteboard in his garage with magnets shaped like helmets, and that he once benched a player because the magnet fell off. I'm told he also does a full team walkthrough every Saturday, alone, narrating the plays out loud. None of this is confirmed. I respect it anyway.

Here's the tape on krunkdd's season. 1,211.90 points, seventh in the league. A 62-48 all-play record, tied for fourth. He doesn't win on talent, he wins because he doesn't leave starters on bye. Last week he beat Wild Goose Chase with Derrick Henry (19.0) on the bench, and he still won by 15.22. The simulator has him at 10.5 projected wins and 100% playoff odds.

Week 11 he's a 12.5-point favorite against Bijan is your daddy, whose four best guys are on bye and whose running back is coming off IR Monday night. Carnell Tate is questionable but trending toward playing. Josh Allen, Derrick Henry, James Cook III. This should be over by Sunday night. If it isn't, it'll be because somebody on his roster got hurt, not because krunkdd fell asleep. That's how you play the position.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's seven-step plan for Br0phy's empty FLEX, ranked from good to illegal
columns.dek: Tyjae Spears is on IR. Wild Goose Chase has seven bench spots and nobody to play. Pull up a chair.
body: I've been sitting in this lawn chair since Saturday afternoon, when the Titans put Tyjae Spears on injured reserve, and I haven't moved because I knew Br0phy would need me. Here's the situation, and every number here is real: Spears is in the Wild Goose Chase FLEX, he's out at least four games, and the bench is Drake Maye (out), Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft (all Green Bay, bye), Dylan Sampson (Cleveland, bye), RJ Harvey (IR) and the Seattle defense (bye). That's a bench built like my shed: full, and none of it works.

So here's my plan. 1. Leave Spears in. He scored 30.9 points in 7 games while hurt, so imagine what he does fully rested on IR. Rest is a skill. 2. Start Christian Watson anyway. He has 183.6 points this year, the most on the roster, and a bye is just a game where nobody can tackle him. 3. Move Bryce Young to the FLEX and Drake Maye to quarterback. Two quarterbacks is twice the passing.

4. Do NOT pick up Keon Coleman. Yes, he has 73.5 points in 9 games and plays Sunday for Buffalo. But ChuckJ10 dropped him Friday, and you never take a man's leftovers when you're beating him 19.00 to 0.00. That's just rude. 5. If you must add someone, add Darnell Washington (63.9 points), because he shares a last name with a whole city and that's a lot of home-field advantage.

I'm HEARING things from the folding-chair community, and I'll be honest, none of this is confirmed. Sources say Br0phy saw the Spears news Saturday, opened the app, and spent forty minutes trying to drag Tucker Kraft onto the Titans. Word around the cul-de-sac is he then filed a commissioner request asking for a 'bye-week exemption' that lets him start Green Bay players as long as he watches their highlights from last week. None of this is confirmed. I support all of it.

6. Trust the math. Wild Goose Chase scores 127.56 a week, Nothing to see here scores 105.25, and the line only dropped from 16.5 to 13.5. Three points is nothing. That's one field goal, and Spears isn't even kicking. 7. Go to bed. The 6 seed at 72% playoff odds isn't going anywhere, unless it is.
Real talk from the chair, just this once: put Keon Coleman in the FLEX, cut Spears, and do it before Titans at Cowboys. Then ignore steps 1 through 7. Especially 2.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: three Washington running backs, two fantasy teams, and why Monday night is mathematically a tie
columns.dek: Rachaad White, Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Austin Ekeler have 151.1 combined PPR points. I divided that by everything I could find.
body: Let's talk about the most crowded backfield in this league, and I mean Washington's, not anyone's bench. On Monday night against Cincinnati, Llamageddon starts Rachaad White, who has 75.9 PPR points in 8 games and was added to Friday's injury report with a heel. Bijan is your daddy starts Jacory Croskey-Merritt, 44.9 points in 5 games, who is expected off injured reserve and is still listed on IR by Sleeper as of Sunday morning. And on Saturday night FatMikeR added Austin Ekeler, 30.3 points in 6 games, and dropped Jordan Watkins.

Now the analysis. Add them up and you get 151.1 points across 19 games played, which is 7.95 points per back per game. Divide by three backs and each one owns exactly 2.65 points of the Washington backfield per game. FatMikeR now owns two of the three backs, so he owns 66.7% of the backfield, which by my model means he's a 66.7% favorite to win a matchup that isn't even against dcrabb. That's how good the number is.

The real numbers keep going. Bijan is your daddy is 4-6 and a 12.5-point underdog to Ivefallenandicantgetup, a 66% line. FatMikeR has spent $0 of his $200 FAAB, the only owner in the league still at $0, and both of his Washington backs cost exactly nothing. That's a points-per-dollar rate of infinity, which is the highest number I'm legally allowed to publish.

Sources tell me, and I want to stress that nobody has confirmed this, that dcrabb has built a spreadsheet tracking which of the three Washington backs sits closest to the Gatorade cooler on the sideline, on the theory that the cooler is where the snaps get handed out. I'm told FatMikeR answered by adding Ekeler purely so he could own 'the cooler side' of the bench. None of this is confirmed, and I've never seen a cooler score a touchdown.

Here's my conclusion. Llamageddon is a 13.5-point underdog to Lead Nagger and Bijan is your daddy is a 12.5-point underdog, so the two Washington-dependent teams are separated by exactly one point. One point is basically zero, which means both teams are tied, which means Monday night is a tie, which means I'm right. Numbers don't lie. I just help them along.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: Stroud of Turin vs. NjigbaR Please!: the season-high team against a contender with four starters on bye
items.dek: The projected 5 seed against the projected 2 seed, a 253.7 total, and the bye week does the handicapping.
body: On paper this is the best game of Week 11. Stroud of Turin is 6-4, scores 129.79 a week, has a 68-42 all-play record and just put up 194.14 with a perfect lineup, the best score in the league this year. NjigbaR Please! is 7-3 with a 67-43 all-play record and scores 123.96 a week. The Climax Bracket has them as the 5 and 2 seeds, and the total is 253.7.

The scoring gap is only 5.83. The line is Stroud of Turin by 11.5 because NjigbaR Please! loses four Week 10 starters to byes: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (32.1 last week), Kyren Williams, Harold Fannin Jr. and KC Concepcion Jr. Stroud of Turin loses Quinshon Judkins and DeMario Douglas. That's a 6-point nudge, and Stroud of Turin is a 64% favorite.

Thursday is in the books, and it went exactly how the line said it would, only more. C.J. Stroud threw three touchdowns for 21.46 and Xavier Hutchinson added 3.3, so Stroud of Turin leads 24.76 to 0.00 before NjigbaR Please! plays a snap. dstafford4254 has Alvin Kamara, Kaelon Black and Jordyn Tyson (chest, limited Thursday) in the lineup this time, the same three who scored 50.0 on the bench last week, plus Ashton Jeanty and Travis Kelce. Stroud of Turin still has Ja'Marr Chase, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Chuba Hubbard to come. The pick stays Stroud of Turin by 11.5, and it has a 24.76-point cushion. Saturday: dstafford4254 spent Friday night swapping Dohnte Meyers for Myles Price and adding and dropping the bye-week Rams defense inside a minute before landing on Carolina. That is not what a team down 24.76 needs.

body: This is the lowest total of Week 11, 217.0, and it's my game, so here's the honest version. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-9 with the fewest points in the league (1,000.76) and a 21-89 all-play record. My Dad is Dead2 is 7-3 with a 52-58 all-play record, scores 116.96 a week and has left 184.92 points on the bench this season, the most in the league. Yes, that's me.

The line is the 16.89-point scoring gap, rounded to 16.5, no nudge. Both sides took hits: My Dad is Dead2 has Jordan Addison, DeVonta Smith and Kyle Monangai listed as out per Sleeper, Wan'Dale Robinson questionable, and Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield on the Rams' bye. MY DAD IS DEAD loses Tyler Higbee to the bye and has Ladd McConkey and T.J. Hockenson out. My Dad is Dead2 is a 70% favorite.

Nothing has counted yet: neither team had a starter on Thursday. Seth McGowan scored 6.48 on the MY DAD IS DEAD bench and left with a hamstring injury. On my side, Wan'Dale Robinson is out for the season, so I traded Jordan Addison (thumb surgery) to Pudge247 for Chimere Dike and put Dike in the lineup, and DeVonta Smith is off the injury report and in my FLEX. OneSillyBannana gets T.J. Hockenson back at full practice, while Ladd McConkey (questionable) sits. If OneSillyBannana starts the right guys and I start the wrong ones, which we both have a track record of, this still gets ugly. The line stays 16.5.

The line opened at Wild Goose Chase by 16.5 after a 6-point nudge toward Nothing to see here: Drake Maye is out with an ankle injury, and Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft, Dylan Sampson and the Seattle defense are all on bye. Bryce Young is the only Wild Goose Chase quarterback with a game. On Sunday it moved 3 more points to 13.5, a 67% favorite, because the Titans put Tyjae Spears on injured reserve Saturday and Br0phy has no healthy bench player to replace him.

Thursday helped. Nico Collins caught three balls for 58 yards and a touchdown (15.8) and Tyler Warren added 3.2, so Wild Goose Chase leads 19.00 to 0.00, and Woody Marks sat out for Nothing to see here. Br0phy fixed the Tucker Kraft hole Friday night with Tyjae Spears, who then went on IR Saturday. As of Sunday morning Spears is still in the FLEX, and the best healthy free agent with a game is Keon Coleman, whom ChuckJ10 dropped Friday. ChuckJ10 has Mark Andrews and Makai Lemon in the lineup and added Kalif Raymond.
